content.value_statement: Campaign results often arrive as disconnected metrics that are hard for stakeholders to use. This skill turns computed influencer performance data into clear reports with narrative, context, recommendations, and audience-specific structure.
actual_capabilities: Builds executive, client, team, and board report structures for influencer campaigns.
Transforms supplied reach, engagement, conversion, spend, revenue, ROI, and ROAS metrics into stakeholder-ready narrative.
Pairs metrics with context such as targets, benchmarks, prior periods, or stated assumptions.
Suggests chart and table formats for the metrics included in the report.
Ends reports with recommendations, action items, and handoff guidance for the next skill.
limitations: It does not calculate raw performance metrics; use performance-analyzer or roi-calculator first.
It needs accurate campaign inputs from the user or prior skill outputs.
It cannot fetch live analytics unless a compatible connector supplies the data.
Financial claims and client-facing conclusions still need human review before publication.

use_cases.title: Brief executives after a campaign
use_cases.description: Create a short report focused on ROI, ROAS, revenue impact, strategic wins, and next investment decisions.

use_cases.title: Package results for clients
use_cases.description: Turn campaign metrics into a client-facing performance story with delivered value, content highlights, and next steps.

use_cases.title: Run a team retrospective
use_cases.description: Produce a detailed internal report that captures creator performance, content learnings, issues, and optimization actions.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a basic report
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single finished campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a client report for [campaign name]. Use these metrics: [reach], [impressions], [engagement rate], [conversions], [spend], and [revenue]. Include a short summary and recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Create an executive summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an executive summary for [campaign name] covering [period]. Focus on ROI, ROAS, revenue, top creators, target performance, and budget recommendations for the next period.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a team retrospective
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an internal team report for [campaign name]. Include creator-level results, content patterns, missed targets, operational issues, action items, owners, and deadlines.

prompt_templates.title: Build a board-ready report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for strategic reporting across multiple campaigns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a board report for [campaign group] covering [period]. Compare campaigns against targets and prior period results, summarize business impact, call out risks, and recommend investment changes.

output_examples.input: Executive report request with spend, revenue, reach, creator count, and ROAS for a holiday campaign.
output_examples.output: A concise executive summary with a bottom-line verdict, target-versus-actual table, strategic highlights, and a budget recommendation.

output_examples.input: Client report request with delivered impressions, engagement rate, conversions, content highlights, and campaign objectives.
output_examples.output: A client-facing performance report that explains value delivered, shows goal progress, highlights top content, and lists next actions.

output_examples.input: Team retrospective request with creator-level performance, content formats, issues, and lessons learned.
output_examples.output: An internal report with performance patterns, optimization learnings, owner-based action items, and recommendations for the next test.

best_practices: Provide computed metrics, targets, and benchmarks before asking for the report.
Name the audience so the report can use the right level of detail and tone.
Review financial claims, attribution notes, and recommendations before sending the report externally.
anti_patterns: Do not ask this skill to invent missing reach, revenue, ROI, or ROAS numbers.
Do not use the same report depth for executives, clients, and internal teams.
Do not publish a report without context for targets, benchmarks, or prior periods.

faq.question: Does this skill calculate ROI or ROAS?
faq.answer: No. It presents ROI and ROAS that you provide or that another skill calculated.

faq.question: Which audiences does it support?
faq.answer: It supports executive, client, team, and board reports with different levels of detail.

faq.question: Can it create charts?
faq.answer: It recommends chart and table formats. The final rendering depends on the host tool.

faq.question: Can it use live analytics data?
faq.answer: Only when the user or a compatible connector provides the data. It works without live integrations.

faq.question: Is it useful for paid ads reports?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can present paid ads reporting outputs when RQS and measurement-loop data are supplied.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign name, period, audience, objectives, computed metrics, targets, and key context.
